newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CAMBRIDGE UNIVERSITY BEAT OXFORD UNIVERSITY 23-7.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMBRIDGE UNIVERSITY BEAT OXFORD UNIVERSITY 23-7.

text.p: Cambridge University beat Oxford University 23-7 (halftime 13-7) in the 115th University Match at Twickenham on Tuesday.
Cambridge University- Try: Matthew Singer (2). Conversions: Paul Surridge (2). Penalties: Surridge (2). Drop goal: Surridge.
Oxford University - Try: Trevor Walsh. Conversion: James Averis.
